headline: Markets Await US Employment Report and Central Bank Speeches
summary: Investors focused on the U.S. labor market payroll report alongside monetary authority speeches and economic activity indicators in Europe and Brazil.
why: U.S. payroll reports are key indicators of economic health that heavily influence Federal Reserve interest rate expectations and global market sentiment.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Employment data shifts expectations for monetary policy, impacting broader equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Macroeconomic data releases such as the employment report set the tone for interest rate expectations, triggering volatility across global equities.
